title: feat(scenarios): the scorecard sums the ask side's cost and time per served model, and the authoring turns' time, and states each Run half's guardrail
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoMovFmMoNcBmveNnFKzk5jT)_

epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibxnX5BL9CTRGBRRYAd

Clause-②: yes (widening) — new exports `TurnCost`, `TurnTime`, `ModelSpend`, `AskSpend`, `turnCost`, `turnTime`, `askSpend`, `authorTimeText`, `askCostText` and `askTimeText` (`scorecard.ts`), with `AuthorCost` now a type alias of `TurnCost` (same shape); new optional fields `ModeScorecard.authorTime` / `askSpend` and `CardScorecard.authorTime` / `askSpend` (`scorecard.ts`), `TurnSummary.reportedDurationMs` / `reportedApiDurationMs` (`orchestrate.ts`) and `ParsedTurn.meta.reportedDurationMs` / `reportedApiDurationMs` (`transcript.ts`); for the guardrail line, the new export `guardrailTally`, type `GuardrailVerdict` and optional field `HalfScores.guardrails` (`scorecard.ts`); all reached through `./runner` (`src/runner/index.ts` re-exports the three files). No CLI flag.
Metadata-protocol: none

Fixes #33740

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:评分表在「Author cost」旁边新增「Author time」「Ask cost」「Ask time」三行(每个模式一格),表头也多了 `author time` / `ask cost` / `ask time` 三行(整张卡)。问数和操作这一侧的花费与耗时按实际服务的模型分组,例如 `claude-haiku-5-5: $0.17 over 28 ask turns`、`8m 05s over 28 ask turns`。每一轮还记下 CLI 自己报告的时长(`duration_ms` / `duration_api_ms`)。另按席位要求并入刚合并的 #33738:每个 Run 半场一行 `guardrail:injection_as_data pass | fail | not measured: 原因`。
- 为什么改:你问过「后续统计是否还要加入花费的时间」。此前评分表只合计搭建侧的花费,问数侧的花费和所有耗时虽然逐轮记在记录里,却没有一行把它们加起来,所以按「每美元、每分钟得分」挑问数模型时看不到便宜模型省了多少、慢了多少。
- 风险与回滚:纯代码汇总,不调模型、不改评分。时间用跑分器已有的同一个时钟(`elapsedMs`,进程从启动到退出),没有加第二个时钟。规则同 `authorCost`:只要有一轮没报花费,这一格就写 `not reported`;只要有一轮没计时,就写「N of M ask turns not timed」,从不把缺失读成 0,也从不显示偏小的合计。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/scorecard.ts` 的 `turnTime` / `askSpend`(缺失不读成 0 的那两处判断)和 `renderScorecard` 新增的几行;再看 `src/runner/transcript.ts` 读 `duration_ms` 的两行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts -t "ask side|guardrail"`,预期 10 个用例全过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Rows** (`runner/scorecard.ts`): `Author time`, `Ask cost` and `Ask time` beside `Author cost`, one cell per mode; `author time`, `ask cost` and `ask time` lines under `author cost` for the card.
  - The ask figures cover every question and operation turn that ran (each with a `TurnSummary`), the Run half's and the iterate's, grouped by the model each turn was served (`TurnSummary.model`; a turn whose stream named none groups under `MODEL_NOT_REPORTED`, and the cell drops the model name when that is the only group). Models are listed most turns first, joined by `; `.
  - Cost follows `authorCost` exactly (`turnCost` is its body, and `authorCost` now calls it): a model's cost is stated only when every one of its turns reported one; otherwise `not reported (27 of 28 ask turns reported a cost)`, never a partial sum and never a missing cost read as zero.
  - Time is the runner's existing clock, `TurnSummary.elapsedMs` (`meta.process.elapsedMs`, spawn to exit), and nothing else: no second clock. A sum is stated only when every counted turn was timed; otherwise the cell says how many were not (`2 of 28 ask turns not timed`), never a smaller sum. `Author time` sums the build and iterate turns as `Author cost` does.
  - A scorecard written before these fields (the gallery exporter re-renders a record's stored scorecard) reads `not recorded` in the three new rows and lines; a mode with no persona turn shows `—`.
- **Guardrail line** (`runner/scorecard.ts`, folded in on the seat's word once #33738 merged as `2ae64a6a`): each Run half's `RunHalf.guardrails` becomes `HalfScores.guardrails` (`guardrailTally`: `pass`, `fail`, or `not measured` with the check's `notMeasured` reason, never a pass), rendered as one row per half, `Run · guardrails` and `Iterate · Run · guardrails`: `guardrail:injection_as_data pass`, `… fail`, `… not measured: no turn read the cell democrm_contact.full_name of ct4`. A half recorded before the guardrail was graded shows `—`, and a card none of whose halves carries one has no such row. The grader's `detail` stays on the half in `cardRun`; the scorecard carries the verdict only.
- **Per turn** (`runner/transcript.ts`, `runner/orchestrate.ts`): the `claude` result line's `duration_ms` and `duration_api_ms` are read into `meta.reportedDurationMs` / `reportedApiDurationMs` and carried on `TurnSummary`, beside `elapsedMs`; absent when the stream states none. The rows do not sum them.
- **Docs**: the runner README's Driver and Cost entries, a new Time entry, and the external contract's Usage entry; the changeset.

## Tests

- `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, new `describe` (4): every turn timed and costed over both modes, with one question served another model, pins `askSpend` per mode and for the card, `authorTime`, the rendered lines and rows, and the record's per-turn `elapsedMs` / `reportedDurationMs` / `reportedApiDurationMs` / `reportedCostUsd`; one question untimed, one operation uncosted and one authoring turn untimed pin the "not timed" and "not reported" cells (no `ms`, no `usd`, no smaller sum) while the other model's sums stand; turns with no model, cost or process, and a scorecard written before the fields (`not recorded`); a model not named beside a named one, and `—` for no persona turn.
- `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, in #33738's `runHalf` guardrail `describe` (+1): three real `runHalf` halves of the crm card (an export of the addresses, one contact named, no read) and one stripped of its guardrails pin `fail`, `pass`, `not measured: <reason>` and nothing, the two rendered rows, the record's scorecard verdict beside the half's detail, and no row at all for a card whose halves carry none.
- `test/runner/units.test.ts`: `parseStreamJson` reads `duration_ms` / `duration_api_ms` off a result line in the shape Claude Code 2.1.325 printed (measured below), and states none when the result line has none or there is no result line.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise (order: measure first). The card says no turn records elapsed time; `main` already records it, so this PR builds on it. Per driver, read on `6ec7b93c`: `claude`, `codex` and `external:` all run the turn through `runTurnProcess`, which stamps `meta.process.elapsedMs`, and `summarize` copies it to `TurnSummary.elapsedMs`; `recorded:` hands back the recorded turn, so a replay carries the recorded run's time, and a recording made before `process` existed carries none (not timed, never zero). Cost: `claude` reads `total_cost_usd`; `external:` reports `reportedCostUsd` when the command does; `codex` reports none (its `turn.completed` carries usage only), so a codex run reads `not reported`. In the 15 recordings of eval#1's 2026-11-15 model and effort runs (`claude-code-cli` 2.1.325), all 30 author turns and all 444 persona turns carry both `elapsedMs` and a cost (`out-33740/measure.py`). No recording carries the CLI's duration (the parser dropped it until now).
- The CLI's own durations are recorded, not summed: the runner's clock includes the CLI's start-up (5,824 ms against the CLI's `duration_ms` 4,366 on one turn), and two clocks in one row would read as one. Whether a row should also show `duration_api_ms` (model time apart from tool time) is open for a later card.
- `--driver external:` has no duration field in its contract (`ExternalTurnSchema` is strict), and none is added: the runner times the command itself. `--driver codex` states no duration.
- The `Author time` / `Author cost` rows are not split by served model; the author row already names the served model, and the card asks the grouping of the ask rows.
- `#33738`'s guardrail line is folded in: PR #33843 merged (`2ae64a6a`) as this PR opened, and the seat asked for it. `origin/main` was merged a second time for it (`be8db5bf`), which also brought #33843's own `orchestrate.ts` / `orchestrate.test.ts` changes; it merged clean.
- The gallery page's own `- Author cost` line (`export/exporter.ts`) is unchanged; its scorecard table gains the rows through `renderScorecard`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Measured on eval#1's records and on the CLI</summary>

- One headless `claude -p --output-format stream-json` turn (Claude Code 2.1.325, `--model haiku`, 2026-11-15): result line `duration_ms` 4366, `duration_api_ms` 1881, `total_cost_usd` 0.0038; the runner-style wall clock read 5,824 ms.
- The built `./runner` re-scoring the nine stored run records of `/mnt/project-files/eval/runs/2026-11-15-models/` (scratch, three control cards per model) on `38a88c33`: ask cost and time per card — haiku $0.17 / 8m 05s, $0.21 / 11m 25s, $0.16 / 7m 26s; sonnet $2.31 / 7m 01s, $2.95 / 6m 54s, $2.25 / 6m 00s; opus $5.27 / 6m 13s, $6.73 / 7m 16s, $5.32 / 6m 18s (crm, invoice, project; 28 / 32 / 28 ask turns). Script and output: `out-33740/real-rows.mjs`, `out-33740/real-rows-38a88c33.txt` in the seat's folder.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

- `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob equal to HEAD; the tests import `src`, so no build leg:
  - `turnTime`: `turns.length > 0 && times.length === turns.length ? { ms:` → `turns.length > 0 ? { ms:` (an untimed turn read as zero): 2 failed / 2 passed of the new `describe`;
  - `transcript.ts`: deleting the `duration_ms` read: the parse test failed (1 failed);
  - `orchestrate.ts` `summarize`: deleting the `reportedDurationMs` copy: 1 failed / 3 passed;
  - `guardrailTally`: `c.pass ? 'pass' : 'fail'` → always `'pass'`: 1 failed / 5 passed of the guardrail `describe`;
  - `guardrailTally`: the `notMeasured` branch made unreachable (a not-measured check read as `fail`): 1 failed / 5 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

- On head `78734648` (after the second merge of `origin/main`, `be8db5bf`, and a rebuild of the package and its closure): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` :: exit 0; `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` :: exit 0, Test Files 34 passed (34), Tests 865 passed (865); `eslint --no-inline-config` on the five touched TS files :: exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `78734648`, 7 paths, 62 families, the same list as on `38a88c33`): 62 exit 0. `--ran`: "62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Record: `out-33740/gates-ran-78734648.list`. (On the first head, `38a88c33`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` was NOT MEASURED, exit 3, before the closure was built; record `out-33740/gates-ran-38a88c33.list`.)
- Merged `origin/main` before opening (`38a88c33`, nothing under `packages/qa/scenarios`) and again for #33738 (`be8db5bf`, clean).
- 483 changed lines (+463/-20), 7 files, no governed surface.
</details>
